item.title: Americans face higher back-to-school costs. Here's what's pricier.
item.description: U.S. households will spend roughly $4,000 per student on school supplies and lunches this year, a new analysis found.

item.title: Kenya investigates deaths of 15 elephants in Amboseli National Park
item.description: The Kenya Wildlife Service said 10 of the elephants showed signs of partial paralysis before dying within two days.

item.title: Doctor discusses potential COVID origin after Dr. Anthony Fauci's diary release
item.description: Dr. Anthony Fauci will appear before the Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee on Wednesday after Sen. Rand Paul released over a thousand pages of journal entries from Fauci's pandemic-era diary. CBS News medical correspondent Dr. Céline Gounder joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Videos capture moment 7.1 magnitude earthquake hit Japan and its aftermath
item.description: A deadly 7.1 magnitude earthquake rattled southern Japan on Tuesday, collapsing buildings and sparking fires. These videos show the moment the quake struck and the destruction it left behind.

item.title: Grenada officials reexamining missing American woman's last known movements
item.description: A friend of missing North Carolina woman Liz Waddell, last seen in the Caribbean, informed police of security footage showing the 44-year-old swimming off the coast of Grenada's capital. CBS News correspondent Cristian Benavides reports.

item.title: "60 Minutes" announces new correspondents and contributors
item.description: "60 Minutes" announced ahead of its 59th season that Ross Douthat, Sebastian Junger, Gianna Toboni and Trevor Phillips will join the show.

item.title: Trump calls Graham "beloved friend" and "American original" in eulogy
item.description: President Trump delivered the eulogy for friend and ally Sen. Lindsey Graham, who died unexpectedly just a short time after visiting Ukraine earlier this month.

item.title: Apalachee High School shooter Colt Gray sentenced to life without parole
item.description: A judge on Tuesday sentenced Colt Gray to life in prison without the possibility of parole. Gray pleaded guilty to killing four people in the deadly 2024 shooting at Apalachee High School. CBS News correspondent Skyler Henry has the latest.

item.title: Trump meets with Zelenskyy and Netanyahu amid wars in Iran, Ukraine
item.description: President Trump met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu Tuesday.

item.title: People trapped and injured after powerful earthquake strikes Japan
item.description: A powerful earthquake hit southern Japan, seriously damaging a shopping mall where there are reportedly many people trapped and some feared dead.

item.title: Apalachee High School shooter sentenced to life without parole
item.description: Colt Gray, the teenager who admitted to killing four people in the 2024 shooting at Apalachee High School, will spend the rest of his life in prison without parole.

item.title: Trump meets Netanyahu as his threat to resume strikes looms over Iran
item.description: Trump met Israeli leader Benjamin Netanyahu as the U.S. and Iran held their fire amid work toward a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: DOJ tests limits of never-before-used court to deport suspected terrorist
item.description: The Alien Terrorist Removal Court was created by Congress in 1996 and signed into law by President Bill Clinton. Before now, it had never been used.

item.title: Trump meets with Netanyahu, Zelenskyy at White House ahead of Graham funeral
item.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Tuesday to discuss a number of foreign policy issues ahead of Sen. Lindsey Graham's funeral, which both foreign leaders attended. CBS News' Natalie Brand has the details.

item.title: Watch: Lindsey Graham's niece delivers emotional tribute to late senator
item.description: Lindsey Graham's niece, Emillie Boggs Roberts, honored her late uncle with an emotional speech during funeral services in Washington, D.C. on Tuesday.

item.title: The Lindsay Clancy Case: A Family Tragedy on Trial | Case by Case
item.description: As the trial of Lindsay Clancy is set to begin, Natalie Morales is joined by WBZ-TV Boston reporter and anchor Kristina Rex to examine the case that has drawn national attention and intense public scrutiny. They break down the events leading up to Clancy killing her three young children, the competing arguments expected at trial, and the role mental illness may play in the case.

item.title: The Larry Millete Verdict | Case by Case
item.description: More than five years after Maya Millete was last seen at her Chula Vista home, a jury has found her husband, Larry Millete, guilty of first-degree murder. In this special bonus episode, CBS News legal analyst Caroline Polisi revisits the evidence, the witnesses, and the unanswered questions that defined this no-body murder trial. From allegations of control and marital conflict to digital evidence, missing miles, and the now-infamous spellcaster testimony, we examine the case that captivated Southern California and beyond. And even with a verdict, the central question remains unanswered: Where's Maya?

item.title: Verdict Soon in the Larry Millete Trial | Case by Case
item.description: The prosecution and defense have rested their cases. Jurors heard testimony about Maya Millete's secret relationship, a hidden Instagram account, Larry Millete's communications with an online spiritual practitioner. Prosecutors also questioned witnesses about the digital evidence they say helps reconstruct the events surrounding Maya's disappearance and where investigators searched for her. CBS News legal analyst Caroline Polisi and "48 Hours" consultant Herman Weisberg discuss the significance of witness testimony for the outcome of this trial.

item.title: Watch: Sean Hannity eulogizes late friend Lindsey Graham at funeral
item.description: Sean Hannity eulogized his friend and frequent show guest Lindsey Graham at the late senator's funeral in Washington, D.C. on Tuesday.

item.title: Watch: Trump eulogizes Lindsey Graham at late senator's funeral
item.description: President Trump eulogized late Senator Lindsey Graham in a memorial service at the Washington National Cathedral on Tuesday.

item.title: D4vd Charged with Murder | Case by Case
item.description: Following the discovery of Celeste Rivas Hernandez's remains in a vehicle registered to D4vd last fall, what were the key developments that led to charges this week? On this episode of "Case by Case," we examine all of the new details coming out of the case against singer-songwriter David Anthony Burke, who professionally goes by D4vd. "48 Hours" correspondent Natalie Morales and CBS News chief correspondent Matt Gutman break down what we know so far about Celeste's death and the alleged abusive relationship she had with the singer.

item.title: William Shatner and daughter Melanie recall fighting Stage 4 cancer together
item.description: Actor William Shatner and his daughter, Melanie Shatner Gretsch, recall how they helped each other as they fought Stage 4 cancer side by side.

item.title: Fauci diaries, released by Sen. Paul, touch on COVID origins, Trump
item.description: Republican Sen. Rand Paul released more than a thousand pages of journal entries from Dr. Anthony Fauci, teeing up what is likely to be a contentious hearing on Wednesday.

item.title: William Shatner and his daughter open up about how they battled Stage 4 cancer at the same time
item.description: Legendary actor William Shatner and his daughter Melanie Shatner Gretsch are opening up about their battles with Stage 4 cancer nearly at the same time as each other. Both are now cancer-free and share how they helped each other through the challenging time.

item.title: Biden tapes released after legal battle, with references to classified material
item.description: Audio recordings that former President Joe Biden fought for years to keep private have now been released.

item.title: Grandfather with pancreatic cancer beats the odds with clinical trial
item.description: Hernando Salcedo was diagnosed with Stage 3 pancreatic cancer after mild symptoms. Chemotherapy made him feel worse than before his diagnosis.

item.title: Pregnant mom diagnosed with Stage 4 cancer after symptoms were dismissed
item.description: Jenney Bitner feared she wouldn't get to see her children grow up after a tumor in her brain revealed she had Stage 4 melanoma.

item.title: Strange symptom leads to man's Stage 4 cancer diagnosis
item.description: An app notification informed Joe Gillette that he had been diagnosed with aggressive, late-stage cancer.

item.title: Her Stage 4 cancer had no symptoms. Innovative surgery saved her life.
item.description: A chance emergency room visit led to Amy Piccoli's diagnosis with late-stage colorectal cancer.
